research_question: RQ-ED1: Can System construct non-judgmental Decision-Relevant Evidence Cues from existing Frozen Evidence?

is_in_table.detection_method: y-alignment + x-gap >= 12pt + >= 3 consecutive multi-column rows + column stability >= 70%
is_in_table.safe_translation: within a detected multi-column aligned structure

tld_audit.critical_finding: is_in_table=False appears in both MERGE (AMB-414/422) and KEEP_SEPARATE (AMB-313/519) cases — TLD alone does NOT determine judgment. This is a feature: the cue provides context without dictating the answer.

evidence_relevance_analysis.question: Why does h_gap=27.2pt produce no Human feedback despite being correct?
reasons: Decision relevance gap (relationship matters, not distance)
Comparison without reference (27.2pt has no meaning without context)
Redundancy with visual evidence (page image already shows gap)

information_abundance_analysis.verdict: Information Abundance is a RELEVANCE problem, not a quantity problem
information_abundance_analysis.caveat: n=1; P01 achieved 3.9s/item suggesting fast selection; other participants might differ

b_phase.attribution: DISTILLATION_GAP (TLD data not propagated to group representation)

c_phase.attribution: Mixed: Relevance Loss + Missing Heterogeneity Exposure
c_phase.root_cause: TLD data not propagated from L2 to L4 Compression

distillation_boundary.boundary_3: Semantic Interpretation Candidate — risks automation bias
distillation_boundary.is_stable_layer: POTENTIALLY (more than presentation trick, less than new architecture)
